$comment: Why an analysis job failed: the codes the worker writes to jobs.error_code, and what the web tells the learner (STYLE_GUIDE section 7). Shared by pipeline/src/isai/worker/errors.py and web/src/api/jobErrors.ts; tests on both sides check every code is here.

decode_failed.message: Isai couldn't read that file as audio.
decode_failed.next: Try exporting it again as MP3 or WAV, then upload it once more.

too_long.message: That recording is longer than Isai can analyse.
too_long.next: Trim it to under 12 minutes and upload it again.

silent.message: Isai couldn't hear anything in that recording.
silent.next: Check the file plays with sound, then upload it again.

unsupported_type.message: Isai can't analyse that kind of recording yet.
unsupported_type.next: Choose piano solo, full song or voice only, then upload it again.

model_failed.message: The analysis machine hit a problem with one of its models.
model_failed.next: Try again later. If it keeps happening, tell the owner.

timeout.message: The analysis took too long and was stopped.
timeout.next: Try a shorter recording, or upload it again later.

upload_expired.message: The analysis didn't start within a day, so the audio was deleted.
upload_expired.next: Upload the recording again when the analysis machine is back.

internal.message: Something went wrong while analysing your song.
internal.next: Upload it again. If it keeps happening, tell the owner.
